My experience with InCred has been extremely awful and mentally exhausting. Taking a loan from them feels like stepping into a financial trap that only gets deeper with time.

Before I even left India for my studies, InCred collected ₹2 lakhs as installments for the 2 years of my study period, in addition to the processing fee. This was done upfront, without clearly explaining how this would impact my overall loan or interest calculation.
What was never clearly explained was the reality of the so-called moratorium period.
